name_zh: 锂三角/资源民族主义：资源诅咒缓解与绿色能源主权
name_en: Lithium Triangle/Resource Nationalism: Resource Curse Mitigation & Green Energy Sovereignty
description_zh: 玻利维亚乌尤尼盐湖拥有全球最大锂储量(2100 万吨/全球 25%+)，锂三角(玻利维亚/智利/阿根廷)主导全球锂供应。核心治理张力：资源民族主义(国有化/本地加工/电池产业链) vs 外资技术/资本/市场准入 vs 环境/水资源/原住民权益。体现 M168 资源诅咒缓解/绿色能源主权 — 以"锂主权国家化+本地化全产业链+环境水资源守护+原住民收益共享"四位一体，在绿色能源转型全球争夺/水资源匮乏/原住民权益三重约束中实现资源主权与产业升级双重目标。
description_en: Bolivia Uyuni salt flat holds world's largest lithium reserves (21Mt/25%+ global), Lithium Triangle (Bolivia/Chile/Argentina) dominates global lithium supply. Core governance tension: resource nationalism (nationalization/local processing/battery value chain) vs foreign tech/capital/market access vs environment/water/indigenous rights. Exemplifies M168 Resource Curse Mitigation/Green Energy Sovereignty — quaternity of 'lithium sovereignty nationalized + localized full value chain + environment/water guardianship + indigenous benefit sharing' achieving dual goals of resource sovereignty & industrial upgrading amid triple constraints of global green energy scramble/water scarcity/indigenous rights.
reason_zh: 玻利维亚锂非单纯资源，而是"主权+产业链+环境+原住民"四位一体绿色能源战略资产。莫拉莱斯/阿尔塞推行国有化/本地化/中资/俄资合作，拒绝单纯出口碳酸锂。M168 区隔于 M169 后石油转型(沙特)、M171 资源民族主义(委内瑞拉)、M189 大人制(蒙博图)，核心在于"锂主权即国家安全+本地化即产业升级+水资源即生存红线+原住民即权益主体"的绿色能源时代资源治理新范式。
reason_en: Bolivian lithium not mere resource but 'sovereignty + value chain + environment + indigenous' quaternity green energy strategic asset. Morales/Arce drive nationalization/localization/Chinese/Russian cooperation, refuse mere lithium carbonate export. M168 distinct from M169 Post-Oil (Saudi), M171 Resource Nationalist (Venezuela), M189 Big Man (Mobutu), core: 'lithium sovereignty as national security + localization as industrial upgrade + water as survival redline + indigenous as rights subjects' new resource governance paradigm for green energy era.
steps_zh: 锂主权国家化与 YLB 成立：2008 矿业法/2017 YLB 玻利维亚锂业公司/国家控股/合资谈判/技术转让条款/本地加工强制
本地化全产业链构建：碳酸锂→氢氧化锂→电池材料→电池芯→电动车/储能/中资/俄资/德资合作/技术转让/人才培养
水资源环境守护红线：乌尤尼盐湖卤水蒸发/淡水稀缺/原住民用水/生态监测/环评/气候变化/水权优先于锂利润
原住民收益共享与咨询权：2009 宪法咨询权/自由事先知情同意/FPIC/收益分成/社区项目/教育/医疗/基建/文化保护
绿色能源地缘博弈与未来：欧盟/美国/中国/电动车产业链/关键矿产安全/玻利维亚/智利/阿根廷/墨西哥/锂 OPEC 概念/产业链主权
steps_en: Lithium sovereignty nationalized & YLB creation: 2008 Mining Law/2017 YLB Bolivian Lithium Corp/state control/JV negotiations/tech transfer clauses/local processing mandatory

Localized full value chain construction: lithium carbonate -> lithium hydroxide -> battery materials -> battery cells -> EVs/storage/Chinese/Russian/German cooperation/tech transfer/talent development
Water resource environmental redline: Uyuni brine evaporation/freshwater scarcity/indigenous water use/ecological monitoring/EIA/climate change/water rights priority over lithium profits
Indigenous benefit sharing & consultation rights: 2009 Constitution consultation/FPIC/revenue sharing/community projects/education/health/infra/cultural protection
Green energy geopolitical game & future: EU/US/China/EV value chain/critical minerals security/Bolivia/Chile/Argentina/Mexico/Lithium OPEC concept/value chain sovereignty
expected_zh: 以"锂主权+本地化产业链+水资源红线+原住民权益"四位一体，在绿色能源转型全球争夺/水资源匮乏/原住民权益三重约束中实现资源主权与产业升级双重目标，为关键矿产资源治理提供绿色时代新范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'lithium sovereignty + localized value chain + water redline + indigenous rights' achieves dual goals of resource sovereignty & industrial upgrading amid triple constraints of global green energy scramble/water scarcity/indigenous rights, providing new resource governance paradigm for critical minerals in green energy era.
case_zh: 2008 矿业法/2017 YLB/2019 莫拉莱斯危机/2020 阿尔塞/中资/俄资/德资合作/2023 首批碳酸锂/电池级/产业链本地化进行时/水资源冲突持续，锂主权艰难前行。
case_en: 2008 Mining Law/2017 YLB/2019 Morales crisis/2020 Arce/Chinese/Russian/German cooperation/2023 first lithium carbonate/battery grade/value chain localization ongoing/water conflicts persist, lithium sovereignty difficult journey.
